# EDUWILLS — AI Quiz Generator for Nigerian Students

EDUWILLS helps Nigerian learners study smarter with AI-powered quizzes generated around books and learning goals.

## Key Features
- AI-generated multiple-choice quizzes from selected books
- Support for WAEC, JAMB/UTME, NECO and general Nigerian exam preparation
- Learner AI study assistant for books, characters, themes, vocabulary and study strategies
- Cross-device quiz question caching and rotation
- Progress tracking and quiz history

## How It Works
1. Search for a book title or author.
2. Select a verified book and configure a quiz.
3. EDUWILLS researches the selected book and generates questions.
4. Take the quiz and review your performance.
5. Ask EDUWILLS AI follow-up study questions when you need help.

## Exam Preparation
EDUWILLS is an independent study tool and is not affiliated with WAEC, JAMB or NECO.

## SEO Topics
WAEC practice questions; JAMB CBT mock test; JAMB past questions; NECO exam preparation; Nigerian exam prep; AI quiz generator; book quiz generator; UTME practice online.
